environment: 127.0.0.1:3010 isolated empty-data server, Codex in-app browser; no real provider calls

changes.manualScale: Added a visible More Settings UI Scale selector with Auto, 75%, 90%, 100% and 125% options. It uses the existing StudioScale.set API and posts the selected mode to active and future embedded pages.
changes.canvasListLanguage: Connected the project workspace title, project/trash controls, board header, empty state, refresh/reset controls and new-canvas controls to the existing i18n modules. Default Project is translated while user-created project names remain unchanged.
changes.onlineRatios: Added i18n keys to the 3:4 and 4:3 ratio options, English translations in the studio dictionary, and refreshed the online page, i18n module and parent iframe cache versions.

observations.refresh: After reload, 125% remained selected and applied to the embedded canvas list; after switching to Auto and reloading, the selector showed Auto and the embedded page returned to the responsive 0.766 scale.

observations.englishDark: With English and dark theme enabled, the main page and canvas-list iframe reported lang=en, studio-theme-dark and 125% scale. Canvas list visibly showed Projects, Default Project, Trash, No canvases yet, Create the first canvas for this project and New canvas.

observations.chineseRestore: Switching back to Chinese changed the canvas-list labels back to 项目、默认项目、回收站、暂无画布 and 新建画布 without a reload.

observations.onlineRatios: Before the fix, the isolated 3010 online-image iframe showed 3:4 竖图 and 4:3 横图 while English was selected. After reloading the parent page with its updated online iframe URL, the root task verified that English showed 3:4 Portrait and 4:3 Landscape, and switching back to Chinese immediately restored 3:4 竖图 and 4:3 横图.
